en.text: Thank you for watching, and I'll see you in the next video. Bye!
Well, that's all I can say. Thanks for watching. I hope you enjoyed the video. I'll see you in the next one. Bye! AAH!
Oh ho ho ho ho ho ho!
They took out the Pigeon Lady!
The guardians will deal with them.
I knew I could count on you, old friend…
I wish I had you on the expedition…
They were fools for getting close to her…
They're cursing Lady Geist's name for sure…
He's as dangerous as they said… but at least he's on our side
So that's what the OSIC does…
Remind me never to get on her hit list…
Turns out the government actually is here to help. Hm.
Your reputation is well earned, Haze…
I love working with you, Infernus…
We made short work of that…
You know how to make an entrance, Lash…
You know how to use a bow, sir…
Thanks for the help, Grey Talon
Talon was looking out for us.
They took out the Rat King!
That's… probably why The Baxter Society never kicked him out.
Even his hair still looks perfect…
The man's a force of nature…
They don't have a chance against Shiv!
Damn it, they took out Ivy!
Ivy, I knew I could depend on you…
This is like being frozen in ice without the trauma…
Nononono, this won't be my legacy.
This story will have a happy ending, even if I have to kill everyone myself…
No one's getting the Rejuvenator but us!
I need to stay sharp, I don't have any backup…
It's getting a little rough out there…
They'll have to try harder than that if they want to kill me…
Today is not the day I die…
I don't like the way things are going…
A change of plans is needed, yes?
Of course this isn't good, but I've been in worse spots.
Well… if things go wrong, there's always scotch.
This was a lot more fun when we were winning…
I believe its time for a different approach…
I must admit, they're putting up a fight.
I knew we could work together!
We keep this up, and it will be over in no time!
We make a good team, yes?
I'm not dead yet! Well. Technically, I suppose I'm a wight but let's not get bogged down by specifics..
I won't meet my final death!
Thought you had me, didn't you…
All I need is a little more time…
Damn it, I froze the objective.
All good things come to an end…
You'll have to try harder than that, Bebop…
You're not as smart as you think you are, Paradox…
I've been put in worse death traps…
You'll have to be faster if you want to catch me, Paradox…
Your machines aren't getting it done, McGinnis…
I'll deal with McGinnis' little toys…
How many of these things does she have?
They picked up the rejuv, we can't afford to make mistakes!
Geist is looking to steal your health…
If it makes you feel better, I got lucky…
You were never getting away, Haze…
Infernus, you didn't think that would work did you?
Everyone needs to be humbled, Lash…
When this is over we will celebrate!
What chance do they have against us?
I am with you, my friend.
Come out and face me with courage!
Only a rat feels the need to hide…
Don't feel bad, my friend, no one is better than me.
If you were going to lose, at least you lost to the best, yes?
They throw their lives away with such gusto…
It appears they've confused courage with stupidity.
Your intentions are noble, Sheriff, but I can't let you win…
You came a long way to fail, Sheriff…
We're all looking for answers, Holliday… sadly you won't be getting yours today.
That lasso was never going to get it done.
Never was a fan of pigeons.
You should have stayed in the park
Bebop, I really wish you'd stop trying to kill me.
I'm not afraid of you, Bebop.
That young lady has a bright future ahead of her, but today she will be a failure.
I hate to stifle such imagination.
Today we are enemies, but hopefully tomorrow we shall be allies.
I'll have to pick up her record later…
You have many talents Cadence, combat is not one of them
It didn't have to be this way, Solomon
I have to fight for this, Solomon.
Paradox is no longer a threat.
We need not worry about Paradox…
You're clever, Paradox, but you're not better than me.
Sometimes the march of progress needs to be stopped
Took out the snake oil salesman
I'm not interested in your sales pitch
I put an end to your tricks, Doorman.
No more reality bending for you, my friend.
You won't pray on us, Drifter.
No more innocents will suffer at your hands.
A pity I couldn't stop him sooner.
I'm sorry, my friend, but I can't let you win.
I wish I didn't have to do that, Professor.
If I never see a black hole again, it will be too soon.
He'll find his way home eventually….
His arrogance reminds me of an old friend…
This is not your day, young man.
Perhaps you should focus on your studies, Apollo.
McGinnis, you deserve more than being a lacky for Maximillian.
You're no better than Calico, McGinnis.
I could never trade my morals for coin like that woman…
You made your choice when you signed with Fairfax Industries…
I was hoping us corpses could stick together…
I wish you good luck on your search, my friend, but I can't let you win.
Sadly my search for the truth has to trump your own.
If you wanted to be glass half full, at least he's not in pain.
You're the monster, Geist, not Oathkeeper…
I won't be fed to your pet spirit, Geist.
That woman needs to be stopped…
I won't let that monster get what she wants.
Seven could only elude consequences for so long…
Glad I took her out before she killed us all.
They may have the money, but WE have the talent…
Your cause is just, Vindicta, but your methods…
I suppose now is probably a bad time to give a lecture on violence…
See you at the bar later?
And here I thought your fire starting days were behind you, Infernus…
Infernus, back to your old tricks I see.
You two are fun guys, sorry about shooting you.
Nothing personal, Mo, it's just business.
They're a scrappy pair, aren't they?
Eh, I don't see what the big deal is.
That solves our little lash problem…
Your tricks won't work on me.
I put an end to the magicians' act.
Sinclair, I'm afraid your act had a shelf life
You couldn't escape from me, Sinclair
I empathize with the Djinn, but their fight isn't my own…
You're a man of principals, Mirage, I respect that…
There's no shame in losing to me, Mirage…
That cat deserves better than you, Calico…
You have no dominion over me, child.
It may be time for you to find a new mentor, Graves.
The lich will only lead you to ruin, Graves.
Graves, you have made questionable life choices.
I'm sorry, Grey Talon, I don't have a choice.
There are other ways to seek justice, Talon.
I'm sorry for your loss, Talon, but this isn't going to solve anything.
I never thought I'd be at war with the Vatican.
Come Venator, and learn that I'm not easy prey.
You'll have to try harder, Venator.
You don’t have what it takes to stop me, Venator.
How can so much anger fill up such a tiny man?
Billy, you need to relax and enjoy life.
Billy, hating life won't get you very far.
One less rat in the fight.
You're just a bully, Shiv… and I hate bullies.
You want to pick on someone, Shiv? Pick on me.
You give the Baxter Society a bad name, Shiv…
It'll take more than knives to stop me!
Take your knife throwing act somewhere else!
This is not your day, Pocket.
This can't be the life you want for yourself, pocket…
I wish I was fighting alongside you, not against you…
Ivy won't be helping her team for a while…
Celeste, I won't let you stop me.
She seemed like a pleasant enough lady.
You have much to learn, Mina.
Maybe you're not as invincible as you think you are, Mina.
She's precarious, to put it mildly.
Vyper's an odd one, that's for sure.
She certainly has a… unique personality.
Alas, Vyper, I have not acquired a taste for your charm.
She won't be harassing us for a bit.
Go back to The Deep, Viscous, it's safer.
The surface is no place for a sea anemone.
That goo suit was only going to last for so long.
You're not the law, Warden, you're just a glorified bounty hunter…
Your goals are noble, Warden, your tactics less so.
I won't back down from you, Warden.
I'll stand up to you, Warden, no matter the costs.
The werewolf has been dealt with.
I won't be stopped by the likes of you, Silver.
Don't have to worry about Wraith anymore.
I may not bleed, but that doesn't mean I'm looking to get stabbed.
A sword was never going to be enough…
I almost feel bad for them.
There's no shame in surrender, friends.
I came to fight the best, and so far I'm sorely disappointed.
It would appear that I'm on a roll, yes?
It's not your fault you're not better than me, it just is what it is.
If only Ettrick could see me now…
Will none of you rise to the challenge?
And once again, I am all alone.
Don't worry, friends… I'll do my best to slow them down.
I won't let the team down.
I must help my new friends!
No one can win this battle on their own…
You're on your own for now.
I'll be back when I can.
This battle is taking its toll.
The dead rarely are consumed by fashion.
My friend, I wish I knew… I'm just looking for answers.
If we work together, victory is assured.
My friend, the grave has no time for pessimism .
Detective… now more than ever we need hope, not skepticism.
Trust me my friend, sometimes it’s the only thing that does.
Are you sure you're up for this miss?
The ritual is about to start.
What are you going on about.
I understand. Just know that I'll do whatever I can to help you both.
I wish I knew. A little of both I suppose.
It makes as much sense as me talking to an animated scrap pile, yes?
They'll be more than one my friend.
Today either our success or our failure will be etched into history.
Stories will be written. Bibliomancers like yourself will read them to children…
You will never be forgotten. Your deeds will never-
You will never be forgotten. Your deeds will never be—
I don't suppose you brought a copy of one of my books.
Because then there would be two of me. And what man or beast could stand against that.
I hope your parents are doing well Paige.
I'm not great. I was. But now…
And I look forward to writing about them… but first we must complete the ritual.
Is now really the time to carry around a board game?
I don't know if metaphors are going to keep you alive in a firefight.
I think the dynamics are clear, it's my job to support you.
Your point is well made, now shut up.
If you see Mr. Fairfax please tell him that I appreciate his investment in my last expedition.
I want to live my life, not hide in a lab.
I've heard there are fascinating mysteries afoot at The Baroness.
Perhaps I should arrange a stay.
Was that intended as a compliment?
I don't know what you are.
This is a little different than an expedition.
Just wondering if getting the answers I seek is worth helping you in the process.
I don't want to work with someone like you.
I understand that violence is going to happen in the ritual, but it's not necessary for you to make them suffer.
Haven't seen you since the Black Chateau.
It certainly does cut down on socializing.
This story writes itself: two men of science fighting to get our lives back.
You picked out a gift yet?
You won't have to settle, Professor. We'll win this day.
Stay inside my dome, little one, it will protect you.
It's a result of becoming a revenant.
It's not a why so much as a how.
And you thought this Ritual was your ticket home?
Family can be complicated, I'm sorry.
I suppose that begs the question if I'm even human anymore.
Why risk your life doing this? You already have money and power.
Why did your father send you here?
You have a curious way of respecting his concerns.
Look at us: a couple of walking corpses ready to stare death in the eye.
Why not? It's better than the alternative.
My friend: we were gifted unnatural life. Don't squander it, travel. Write a book. Find love.
Do you have a plan for the battle, my morose friend.
I'll do whatever I can to keep you in the fight Victor.
I never got to say thank you for your patronage Lady Geist.
I'm serious. Obviously the expedition didn't go as planned, but we wouldn't have had the opportunity were it not for your funding.
I don't know, but I intend to find out.
You seem to be short on friends Lady Geist
That way of thinking is a fast path to a lonely life… you'll realize that when you're older.
I don't know. I tried to find him when I returned to New York but it's like he's vanished.
I wish I could share that sentiment
No barbed words before the ritual?
What you see in people's dreams has to be fascinating.
Is this a friendly request for a chat or a threat?
I take it I should make myself… unavailable after the ritual?
Stay close to me Haze, I'll be able to heal you in my ice dome.
Why do I have the feeling that you already robbed me.
I'm not sure what to say to that
You have so many gifts and yet you waste them on petty theft and childish stunts.
Why? I'm an explorer, not a thief.
That feels like a gross oversimplification.
I've watched your career from afar Miss McGinnis, very impressive.
I'm pretty sure you said Kevin.
Let's not get ahead of ourselves.
Some people say revenant, but I'm not sure if there's really a difference.
Vindicta, my priority will always be saving life; not facilitating you ending it.
It's strange returning after being gone for a year.
Oh, by no means was I trying to draw comparisons… how long did it take you to make sense of the modern world.
A lust for murder isn't purpose Vindicta.
Good to see that Jezebel's is still up and running.
Have faith Infernus, we won't fail.
I look forward to celebrating with you there.
I'm sorry about what's going on in Ixia.
You don't care about what's happening back home?
That came across poorly didn't it.
It's nice to meet someone who actually read them.
I believe the ritual is about to start, but we'll catch up afterwards
Your friendship is inspiring to behold
The djinn have an uphill battle facing them.
Do you think Nashala has a chance at brokering a deal?
I imagine your career choice has taken you to some fantastic locales.
I look forward to reading all about them.
All that rage won't bring your family back.
I create shelter for those in need of aid.
The Baxter Society has done a lot of good.
Shiv, may I ask a favor?
If I ever do lose myself - I want the Baxter Society to put me down.
I need to know what happened.
Are you sure you're ready to replace your father? Leadership isn't as easy as you think.
Not yet, but I hope to fix that today.
Then that will bring into focus how I need to atone.
Be careful, Pocket, Relying on items like that case isn't wise.
Is it? Or is it holding me back?
Alas I'm not as reckless as Ettrick.
No, but I would like to one day.
I see we both know our shapes.
It's a different sort of confused. I don’t know why I'm standing today, or how it happened, or how long it will last, or if I'm even me anymore.
We don't have time for cynicism today Wraith.
I've seen the contempt you have for your fellow man.
Correct. It's time I find answers.
I will endeavor to make sure that's not the case.
This glowing rock could be the only thing keeping me alive so I'm not risking taking it off.
You should be kinder to people Lash
I'm not making an argument, I'm asking you to be nicer.
I'm not sure you should have brought your cat here.
People say that was me at my most humble.
Oh dear? What do you mean oh dear?
Thank you, miss, but no. I don't want to put the families through any more trauma.
When you speak to the fallen, do you need to know their language or is it more of a psychic link?
I was just thinking how helpful that could be in my profession.
Thank her for me, but... I'm not there yet.
I do hope it's a coincidence we've come to New York at the same time.
Here we are, faith and science fighting side by side for the common good.
Then why are you even participating in the Ritual?
I assure you I'd give anything to change that, Billy.
So…. Billy… How did you get the-
You don't look thrilled to be working with me.
Excuse me? The man's a mass murderer.
So how long have you been king?
Other cultures fascinate me. I'd love to learn everything about yours.
You could like me because I'm a person invested in our survival…
You know I could use someone like you on one of my expeditions.
If you change your mind let me know.
I'm already dead so the stakes are a little lower
I don't suppose it would make a difference if I said "please"
Is it true your show has a camel with human hands?
I know you like to stay mobile, but if there's ever an opportunity for the two of us to trap two of them in an ice dome…
I'm no threat to your ambitions.
Luckily, no one's asking you to wear it.
Feel free to keep your distance.
Don't worry about me Mina…I believe we will work exceptionally well together.
I don't think I'm particularly judgmental…
That you've spent more time inside prison than outside of it, so perhaps crime is not what you're best suited for.
I'm not giving you any money.
It's not too late for you to become a hero, Silver.
I would never presume to be someone's role model, but if you find yourself in need of one…
Silver, how familiar are you with Appalachia?
I'm planning an expedition. Expedition might be a bit much let's call it an excursion. Are you interested in being my guide.
I assume you like to work up close?
Then stay close to me, soon our enemies will have no ground to run to.
You asked for this fight, my friend…
I had no choice but to defend myself.
It's in your best interest to stay down.
I don't like how the numbers are looking.
There's nothing to be gained by charging into a fight where I'm outnumbered.
I'll put these souls to good use.
Can't leave souls lying around, now can we?
If no one's going to claim it, I might as well.
Who am I to say no to free souls?
No sense letting this go to waste.
Now that we have the Rejuvenator, what's our plan?
If someone's going to kill me, it's going to be Ettrick, not you…
I didn't take this seriously enough.
Just when I thought my condition couldn't get any sadder…
I won't lie, it's hard to remain optimistic…
I thought we had this, I don't understand…
This is rather dire, now isn't it…
I'm feeling good about this, yes?
Look at us… a couple of miscreants ready to take on the world…
It may be the single malt, but I'm feeling very optimistic.
In life I find that a positive outlook and a freeze ray makes all the difference in the world.
This is dangerous work… fortunately I'm dangerously handsome.
I love making new friends and even newer enemies.
United, no one can break us.
I gotta get to the store…
Might want to get some gear….
I can buy some better gear now…
Maybe now's the time to go shopping…
I can afford some quality merchandise.
I can get some high tier equipment…
There's nothing I can't get at the shop…
I wonder what they have at the curiosity shoppe.
This is the moment I've been saving for…
No worries friends, we got the objective.
We're closer to summoning the Patron.
Ah, well good luck to you in your future endeavors.
A pity we won't be working together.
If you change your mind you know where to find me.
My… condition… will have to wait, I have other matters to attend to.
I need to see the families of my crew mates…
Answers will have to wait…I have a year of lost time to make up for.
Look at you throwing caution to the wind.
Most people would think it’s suicide to go into a battle without me, but you are an individual with no fear of looming failure: and I respect that.
Looks like I have time to finally work on that jigsaw puzzle that’s been haunting me for months.
I've had my fill of the supernatural for now…
If it doesn't kill 'em it will slow them down.
I need to deal with groups.
When the waves come, I'll be ready.
This should keep them at bay.
It's like a snowball, if snowballs could explode and kill you and your neighbors.
What's the point of being a scientist if you don't get to blow things up?
I've learned many things in my travels.
They really hate it when I use this…
Aside from my devastating good looks, this is what else I am known for.
This is why I am feared.
Being an ice wight has its advantages.
Soon they will run from me.
This is why I was chosen.
They will die a frozen death.
Only I can bear the arctic chill safely.
I must be ready to give chase.
It pays to have an exit strategy.
I bring rockefeller plaza wherever I go…
I can go anywhere in this city.
Who knows where the magic ends and the science begins…
A chill wind is about to blow…
I will isolate them from their friends.
I'll fight them on my terms.
I have a few tricks up my sleeve.
It's about to get cold out there.
Let's see how you fare now…
And where, pray tell, do you think you're going?
Let me deal with their magic.
Ready to heal from their pain.
So this is what being Lady Geist feels like.
Let's take out the Pigeon Lady.
Let's take out the Rat King.
Grey Talon, I can heal you!
Rat King, I can heal you!
Check out what The Doorman bought.
Check out what The Drifter bought.
You're on your own for now.
I'll be back when I can.
I'm not ready for a team fight
Check out what Grey Talon bought.
We fought with courage, and now we reap the rewards.
The answers to my condition will no longer elude me.
They fought well, but it wasn't enough.
So friends, who among you is ready to summon an elder god?
This will be an expedition to remember…
I have been given a second chance at life, and I won't squander it.
I'm so close to finding the answers I seek…
We don't have to like each other, but we need to work together as a team.
Once the ritual begins, there's no time for fear or second guesses.
Check out what Rat King bought.
Ready to build an Ice Dome.
We'll be safe in my Ice Dome.
Ready to build a Frozen Shelter.
Nothing will get through my Ice Dome.
When the time comes, I'll build us shelter.
Ready to trap them in my Ice Dome.
